invariants.why: RYTT's load-bearing property is decode(encode(s)) == s. Everything downstream (4Leibniz bridge, Res-Nova fixtures) assumes it. PYTHONPATH=src mirrors CI's `pip install -e .` without mutating the environment
the published spec must not drift from the compiler that implements it
cross-platform serialization agreement; a vector that stops holding means a consumer silently diverges

notes: RYTT is a geometric/semiotic glyph encoding, NOT a compressor. The compression claim was FALSIFIED (it emits 4.2x-10.8x MORE tokens than tiktoken). Token-density figures may be recorded as measured facts; they must never be stated as an advantage, and no 'density' invariant belongs here.
